sentences.text: Manatees -LRB- family Trichechidae , genus Trichechus -RRB- are large , fully aquatic , mostly herbivorous marine mammals sometimes known as sea cows .	family	family (biology)	genus	genus	herbivorous	herbivory

There are three accepted living species of Trichechidae , representing three of the four living species in the order Sirenia : the Amazonian manatee -LRB- Trichechus inunguis -RRB- , the West Indian manatee -LRB- Trichechus manatus -RRB- , and the West African manatee -LRB- Trichechus senegalensis -RRB- .	Trichechus inunguis	Amazonian manatee	Trichechus manatus	West Indian manatee	Trichechus senegalensis	African manatee	Sirenia	Sirenia	Amazonian manatee	Amazonian manatee	West Indian manatee	West Indian manatee	West African manatee	West African manatee
They measure up to 4.0 m long , weigh as much as 590 kg , and have paddle-like flippers .

The etymology of the name is dubious , with connections having been made to Latin `` manus '' -LRB- hand -RRB- , and to a word sometimes cited as `` manati '' used by the Taíno , a pre-Columbian people of the Caribbean , meaning `` breast '' .	Taíno	Taíno people	pre-Columbian	pre-Columbian	Caribbean	Caribbean
Manatees are occasionally called sea cows , as they are slow plant-eaters , peaceful and similar to cows on land .
They often graze on water plants in tropical seas .
